```{r members-data, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(httr)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# --------------------------------------------------

org <- "ISAAKiel"

# project_root is defined in index.Rmd
if (!exists("project_root")) {
  stop("project_root must be defined in index.Rmd")
}

cache_file <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "cache",
  "github_members.rds"
)

cache_max_age <- 24 * 60 * 60  # 24 hours

active_file <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "active_members.csv"
)


# --------------------------------------------------
# GitHub API
# --------------------------------------------------

github_get <- function(url, query = NULL) {

  token <- Sys.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", "")

  args <- list(
    url = url,
    user_agent("ISAAKiel website"),
    timeout(20)
  )

  # GitHub Actions provides GITHUB_TOKEN automatically
  # when passed through the workflow environment.
  # Local rendering works without authentication.
  if (nzchar(token)) {
    args <- c(
      args,
      list(add_headers(
        Authorization = paste("Bearer", token)
      ))
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(query)) {
    args <- c(args, list(query = query))
  }

  response <- do.call(GET, args)

  # Include useful information when an API call fails.
  if (http_error(response)) {

    remaining <- headers(response)[[
      "x-ratelimit-remaining"
    ]]

    stop(
      sprintf(
        "GitHub API request failed (%s): %s%s",
        status_code(response),
        url,
        if (!is.null(remaining)) {
          paste0(" [rate limit remaining: ", remaining, "]")
        } else {
          ""
        }
      )
    )
  }

  content(response, as = "parsed")
}


# --------------------------------------------------
# Fetch organization members
# --------------------------------------------------

fetch_public_members <- function() {

  url <- sprintf(
    "https://api.github.com/orgs/%s/public_members",
    org
  )

  members <- list()
  page <- 1

  repeat {

    result <- github_get(
      url,
      query = list(
        per_page = 100,
        page = page
      )
    )

    if (length(result) == 0) {
      break
    }

    members <- c(members, result)

    if (length(result) < 100) {
      break
    }

    page <- page + 1

    if (page > 100) {
      stop("Unexpectedly large GitHub membership list.")
    }
  }

  if (length(members) == 0) {
    stop("GitHub returned no public members.")
  }

  members
}


# --------------------------------------------------
# Fetch full member profiles
# --------------------------------------------------

fetch_github_members <- function() {

  members <- fetch_public_members()

  profiles <- lapply(members, function(member) {

    user <- github_get(
      paste0(
        "https://api.github.com/users/",
        member$login
      )
    )

    name <- user$name

    if (is.null(name) ||
        length(name) == 0 ||
        is.na(name) ||
        !nzchar(trimws(name))) {

      name <- user$login
    }

    data.frame(
      login = user$login,
      name = name,
      html_url = user$html_url,
      avatar_url = user$avatar_url,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  result <- do.call(rbind, profiles)
  rownames(result) <- NULL

  result
}


# --------------------------------------------------
# Persistent cache
# --------------------------------------------------

load_members <- function() {

  cached <- NULL

  if (file.exists(cache_file)) {

    cached <- tryCatch(
      readRDS(cache_file),
      error = function(e) {
        warning(
          "Could not read GitHub cache: ",
          conditionMessage(e)
        )
        NULL
      }
    )
  }

  # Validate cached data
  required_columns <- c(
    "login",
    "name",
    "html_url",
    "avatar_url"
  )

  if (!is.null(cached)) {

    if (!is.data.frame(cached) ||
        !all(required_columns %in% names(cached)) ||
        nrow(cached) == 0) {

      warning("Invalid GitHub cache; refreshing.")
      cached <- NULL
    }
  }

  # Check cache age
  cache_fresh <- FALSE

  if (!is.null(cached)) {

    age <- as.numeric(
      difftime(
        Sys.time(),
        file.info(cache_file)$mtime,
        units = "secs"
      )
    )

    cache_fresh <- is.finite(age) &&
      age >= 0 &&
      age < cache_max_age
  }

  if (cache_fresh) {
    return(cached)
  }

  # Fetch fresh data.
  # If the API fails, preserve the existing cache.
  fresh <- tryCatch(
    fetch_github_members(),
    error = function(e) {
      warning(
        "GitHub refresh failed: ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(fresh)) {

    dir.create(
      dirname(cache_file),
      recursive = TRUE,
      showWarnings = FALSE
    )

    # Write to a temporary file first
    tmp <- tempfile(
      pattern = "github_members_",
      tmpdir = dirname(cache_file),
      fileext = ".rds"
    )

    tryCatch({

      saveRDS(fresh, tmp)

      if (!file.rename(tmp, cache_file)) {

        if (!file.copy(
          tmp,
          cache_file,
          overwrite = TRUE
        )) {
          stop("Could not update cache file.")
        }
      }

    }, error = function(e) {

      warning(
        "Could not save GitHub cache: ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )

    }, finally = {

      if (file.exists(tmp)) {
        unlink(tmp)
      }

    })

    return(fresh)
  }

  # Fall back to stale cache
  if (!is.null(cached)) {

    warning(
      "GitHub API unavailable; using cached member data."
    )

    return(cached)
  }

  stop(
    "Cannot obtain GitHub members: ",
    "API unavailable and no cache exists."
  )
}


# --------------------------------------------------
# Load data and classify membership
# --------------------------------------------------

user_info <- load_members()

# Read the manually maintained list of active members
if (!file.exists(active_file)) {
  stop(
    "Missing active member configuration: ",
    active_file
  )
}

active_members <- read.csv(
  active_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

stopifnot("login" %in% names(active_members))

active_logins <- tolower(
  trimws(active_members$login)
)

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(active_logins),
  all(nzchar(active_logins)),
  !anyDuplicated(active_logins)
)

# Match GitHub accounts against the active member list
user_info$status <- ifelse(
  tolower(user_info$login) %in% active_logins,
  "active",
  "alumni"
)

# Warn about active members whose organization
# membership is not publicly visible
missing <- setdiff(
  active_logins,
  tolower(user_info$login)
)

if (length(missing) > 0) {

  warning(
    "Active members missing from public GitHub listing: ",
    paste(missing, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Sort alphabetically by display name
user_info <- user_info[
  order(tolower(user_info$name)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Separate active members and alumni
active_info <- subset(
  user_info,
  status == "active"
)

alumni_info <- subset(
  user_info,
  status == "alumni"
)


# --------------------------------------------------
# Render Bootstrap member cards
# --------------------------------------------------

render_member_cards <- function(users) {

  esc <- htmltools::htmlEscape

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(users))) {

    name <- esc(users$name[i])
    url <- esc(users$html_url[i])
    avatar <- esc(users$avatar_url[i])

    cat('<div class="col-xs-6 col-sm-3">')
    cat('<div class="card">')

    cat(sprintf(
      '<a class="img-card" href="%s"
          target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
         <img src="%s" alt="%s" />
       </a>',
      url, avatar, name
    ))

    cat('<br/>')

    cat('<div class="card-content">')
    cat('<h4 class="card-title">')

    cat(sprintf(
      '<a href="%s"
          style="color:#345578;"
          target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
         %s
       </a>',
      url, name
    ))

    cat('</h4><br/>')
    cat('</div>')
    cat('</div>')
    cat('</div>')
  }
}
```

```{r active-members, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
render_member_cards(active_info)
```
